profile.headline: Founding Engineer | AI Agents, Secure Systems & Scalable Integrations
profile.summary:
🌐 Founding Engineer at Cora.ai



I design and build AI agents that help businesses retain and grow their customers, turning cutting-edge research into production systems that deliver measurable value. I thrive at the intersection of AI, applied systems, and real-world problem solving, focusing on materializing benefits rather than just building prototypes.



After years of developing enterprise and government systems, I transitioned to the frontier of AI, exploring conversational agents, automation, and intelligent integrations. I enjoy projects that challenge me to learn continuously, experiment boldly, and see ideas come to life in production.



Having lived in three countries, I bring a global perspective, adaptability, and a collaborative mindset to every project. I’m passionate about technologies that push boundaries, and about building systems that make a tangible impact for people and organizations.

positions.title: Founding Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Founding engineer building AI agents that automate customer retention and expansion workflows.
- Designing conversational interfaces, agent orchestration systems, and secure enterprise integrations.
- Leading full-stack architecture across AI, application, and infrastructure layers.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Software development firm delivering government and cross-border infrastructure systems.
- Led development of border-scale authentication and administrative platforms supporting thousands of daily users.
- Designed real-time credential validation, automation pipelines, and secure system integrations.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built enterprise-grade customizations for Fortune 500 clients, directly supporting renewals and expansions generating up to $10M in revenue.
- Delivered scalable features aligned with complex stakeholder and compliance requirements.
- Partnered cross-functionally to translate business needs into production-ready systems.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led frontend development of a real-time collaboration suite for distributed teams.
- Integrated scheduling, task management, documents, and video features with backend systems.
- Improved performance and UX across core real-time workflows.
